rationale: Lactate and amino acids are primary fermentable substrates. Lactate (8 mmol/gDW/h) + proline (3) + alanine (2) provide 39 mmol C and 6 mmol N. Nitrogen limits growth to 0.60 /h, consuming 27 mmol C. Remaining 12 mmol C is fermented to acetate, propionate, formate, and CO₂. Carbon balance verified.
